verdict.rationale: Core billing objects are documented as available through both the Dashboard and the API: subscriptions, trial offers, Billing Meters and meter events, and webhooks. An official MCP server and CLI also extend programmatic access. Other features are described only as Dashboard flows with no API equivalent shown, including customer portal activation and branding, no-code invoice creation, the no-code migration toolkit, and analytics. No published OpenAPI spec was found at the probed docs paths. missing for 10: explicit API/UI parity statement, API evidence for customer portal configuration, analytics and migration toolkit, discoverable OpenAPI spec, independent hands-on confirmation of parity
